tasks.behavior: Tokens sent to the invoice receiver factory can be returned by the refund authority
acceptance: The factory gets a refund-authority recover(token, to, amount); nobody else can call it, and it can't touch a receiver's money.
Contract tests and the fuzz and invariant suites cover it; docs/contracts/rules.md and operations.md describe it; it ships before the first mainnet deploy.
A receiver's refundable() reads 0 off its intended chain, as factory.status does and refund() allows (audit 2026-11-04); a test covers it.
notes: 2026-11-04 Audit 2026-11-04: InvoiceReceiver.refundable() returns the balance on a wrong chain where refund() reverts. Fix: return 0 when block.chainid != intendedChainId. Any receiver change moves the factory's CREATE2 address (vectors test fails), so it ships with this task's redeploy.

tasks.behavior: The server prepares, checks and tracks sends and transfers from profile wallets
acceptance: An owner with a fresh sign-in prepares a send or transfer; members, keys and stale sign-ins are refused (R-211)
Invalid, zero, token-contract and own-wallet recipients, too-large amounts and failed dry runs are refused; contract and first-send warnings and the network fee are returned (R-211, D-119)
A reported hash moves a send to Sending, the matching final wallet transfer to Sent, a revert or reorg to Failed, and an unreported send drops after 10 minutes (R-212)
openapi.yaml and api.md describe the send routes

proof.1: unit: TestOnlyTheOwnerWithAFreshSignInPreparesASend: owner 201; refreshed token 401 reauth_required; Admin member and another user 403; money.move is in no role and no key scope
proof.2: unit: TestPrepareRefusesWhatWouldLoseMoney, TestPrepareRefusesWhenTheTokenRefuses and TestPrepareWarnsOfANewRecipientAndAContract on Anvil: invalid, zero, token, own and checksum refusals, balance cap, unsponsored chain, reverting token, contract and new-recipient warnings, fee 0 paid by forwend
proof.3: unit: TestASendIsSentOnlyWhenTheChainShowsIt, TestASendFailsWhenItsTransactionMovesSomethingElse, TestUnreportedAndDroppedSendsAreGivenUp and TestOneOpenSendPerWalletAndChain run real transfers through the watcher on Anvil
proof.4: unit: TestProfileRoutesAreAllListed and the openapi route test pass with the four send routes; docs-check passes with api.md Sends and transfers

tasks.behavior: Send and Transfer open one smooth sheet that signs with Privy and follows the send to the chain

Steps slide by direction, the sheet height follows each step, reduced motion shows steps at once, and DESIGN.md describes the pattern (R-213, R-204)
The review shows from, to with a grouped full address, network, token, amount, network fee and what the recipient gets; the button reads Send (R-213, D-119)
On a testnet, a live run signs a sponsored transfer from a profile wallet through Privy without its screens and shows Sending then Sent (R-214)
